appraisal_events.evidence: « Aimé, vous pourrez dire à M. de Stermaria qu'il n'est pas le seul noble qu'il y ait dans cette salle à manger... Ça lui montrera qu'il n'est pas le seul homme titré. Et attrape donc ! Il n'est pas mal de leur rabattre leur caquet à ces nobles. »
appraisal_events.explanation: An unnamed speaker instructs Aimé to relay to Stermaria that he is not the room's only titled guest, explicitly intending to deflate his sense of aristocratic exclusivity.

status_effects.explanation: Stermaria is targeted by a deliberately deflating message that pairs him with a rival noble to puncture his sense of being uniquely titled.

ambiguities: The message is delivered by the unnamed 'bâtonnier', who is not in the alias map or candidate list, so the event source is recorded as 'unknown' rather than a named character.
Marquis de Cambremer is invoked only as a comparison prop to needle Stermaria; the passage gives him no distinct evaluative outcome of his own, so he was omitted despite being a candidate.
